title
Frostdragon Tyrant. Plan your whole lineup in Overwatch.
alliance
Frostdragon Tyrant is fought by alliances, not by states. Each alliance sends up to sixty players into the Dragon Crypt.
map
In the middle is the Capital. Around it are four Spires: Life, Dragonbane, Shield and Blade. They open and close every thirty minutes, and holding one gives your alliance a buff.
tyrant
The rally captain who holds the Capital the longest becomes the Tyrant. So who goes where decides the battle.
create
Admins plan it under Planning, Frostdragon Tyrant. Create the event with its start time in U T C, and every member is asked to vote.
vote
Members vote in Overwatch. I can play, maybe, or can't play, and whether they can join voice.
lineup
Back in planning, every vote is listed, strongest player first. One tap puts everyone who said yes into their own alliance.
assign
Then give each player a target, the Capital or the Spires. Every alliance shows its count, and Overwatch never lets one go over sixty.
notes
Write one rally note per target, like which four joiner heroes to send first. No fixed joiner lists. Frostdragon moves too fast for that.
publish
Publish, and every player gets their alliance, target and rally note. Change a spot later, and that player is told at once.
member
In Overwatch, each player sees exactly where to go.
end
